nodes.description: Owner address of the BotProtected base contract; set to tx.origin in the SINU constructor and used as the only authorized caller in delegate, distribute and list.
Address of the arbitrary Ferrum-style bot protection contract used as the target of low-level calls in checkBots, distribute and list.
Public address of the Uniswap pair for wBNB/this token, computed in the constructor and passed into the bot check call.
Public mapping of token balances; written directly by transferFrom, distribute and list without any internal accounting hook.
Public nested allowance mapping; read and decremented in transferFrom, written in approve and initialized in the constructor.
Public total supply, initialized to 1e27 and used with raw arithmetic in list (totalSupply * 6 / 100).
Hard-coded Uniswap V2 router instance used for the addLiquidityETH external call in list.
Hard-coded WBNB address used to derive the Uniswap pair in the constructor.
Modifier that performs a low-level call to protectionFromBots with selector 0x15274141 and requires the returned success flag before executing the guarded function.
Sets protectionFromBots from the supplied address; the address is fully attacker/user controlled.
Initializes owner to tx.origin, derives uniPair, and grants unlimited allowances to the router and to tx.origin on the pair.
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source.
Payable transferFrom guarded by checkBots; performs raw allowance and balance arithmetic without SafeMath and no reentrancy guard.
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
Owner-only function that performs an unrestricted delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
Internal pure helper that computes the Uniswap pair address from two tokens via CREATE2-style keccak hashing.
Owner-only airdrop that calls protectionFromBots before writing balanceOf entries in a loop; unprotected external call before state changes.
Owner-only listing function that sets balances, calls the router addLiquidityETH with a block.timestamp deadline, then calls protectionFromBots before looping over airdrop recipients.
Caller-controlled address used for sender identity, allowance ownership and owner authorization checks.
Originating EOA used as the owner and as the beneficiary of unlimited allowances.
Miner-influenced timestamp used to compute the router deadline in list.
Low-level .call into the (arbitrary) protectionFromBots contract inside the checkBots modifier, executed before the guarded function body.
Arbitrary a.delegatecall(b) executed in the context of SINU, allowing full storage manipulation by the target code.
Low-level .call to protectionFromBots with selector 0xd5eaf4c3 in distribute, performed before any balance writes.
Low-level .call to protectionFromBots with selector 0xd5eaf4c3 in list, performed before the airdrop loop.
External payable addLiquidityETH call on the Uniswap router using token balance and msg.value with a block.timestamp-based deadline.
Unchecked Solidity 0.7 arithmetic on allowance and balanceOf mappings (allowance -= value, balanceOf[from] -= value, balanceOf[to] += value).
Unchecked raw arithmetic in list: totalSupply * 6 / 100 without SafeMath.
Constructor parameter providing the bot protection contract address in BotProtected.
_from parameter of the checkBots modifier, forwarded to the protection contract call.
_to parameter of the checkBots modifier, forwarded to the protection contract call.
_value parameter of the checkBots modifier, forwarded to the protection contract call.
_to recipient parameter of transfer.
_value amount parameter of transfer.
_from source parameter of transferFrom.
_to recipient parameter of transferFrom.
_value amount parameter of transferFrom.
_spender parameter of approve.
_value amount parameter of approve.
Target contract address parameter of delegate.
Arbitrary calldata parameter of delegate.
First token parameter of pairForUniswap.
Second token parameter of pairForUniswap.
Array of recipient addresses for the distribute airdrop.
Amount assigned to every recipient in distribute.
Amount of tokens supplied to the liquidity pool in list.
Recipient address array for the list airdrop.
Per-recipient amount array for the list airdrop.
Success flag returned from the low-level protection call in checkBots.
Success flag returned from the delegatecall in delegate.

edges.reason: owner is set to tx.origin in the constructor, granting administrative rights to the originating EOA.
The constructor grants allowance[tx.origin][uniPair] = uint(-1) and list credits balances to tx.origin/based owner.
transfer passes msg.sender as the source account to transferFrom.
allowance lookup and deduction in transferFrom are keyed on the caller's msg.sender.
delegate is gated by require(msg.sender == owner), so caller identity controls the privileged delegatecall.
distribute is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
list is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
The router deadline is computed as block.timestamp + 600, making execution time-dependent on miner-controlled timestamp.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom.
The checkBots modifier performs the low-level call to the protection contract.
protectionFromBots supplies the target address of the low-level call.
The external call runs before transferFrom mutates allowance and balances, so the callee can re-enter while state is stale.
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address and calldata.
The owner state variable is the sole authorization requirement for delegate.
delegatecall executes untrusted code in SINU storage context and can re-enter any function before state settles.
distribute performs a low-level call to the bot protection contract.
The external call occurs before the balanceOf writes in the distribution loop, enabling re-entrant state manipulation.
list performs a low-level call to the bot protection contract.
The external call occurs before balanceOf writes in the airdrop loop of list.
list performs an external payable addLiquidityETH call on the router.
The router call executes while SINU balances have already been partially overwritten and before the airdrop loop finishes.
transferFrom performs unchecked subtraction/addition on allowance and balanceOf under Solidity 0.7 semantics.
list computes totalSupply * 6 / 100 without SafeMath, risking overflow.
The SINU constructor calls pairForUniswap to derive the pair address.
The BotProtected constructor stores the supplied address into protectionFromBots.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping for source and destination.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
The uniRouter instance is the receiver of the addLiquidityETH call.
distribute overwrites balanceOf entries for each recipient.
list overwrites balanceOf entries for the contract, the owner and each recipient.
totalSupply is used to compute the owner's share in list.
uniPair is passed as an argument into the bot-protection low-level call inside checkBots.

The _value parameter exists solely to be forwarded into the protection call performed by the checkBots modifier.

Recipient argument consumed entirely by the transferFrom body.
Amount argument consumed entirely by the transferFrom body and its arithmetic.

Amount argument used only to write the allowance mapping in approve.
Target address is used only as the destination of the delegatecall.
Calldata blob is used only as the payload of the delegatecall.
Token address only used to order and hash the pair derivation.
Token address only used to order and hash the pair derivation.
Recipient array drives the balanceOf write loop in distribute.
Per-recipient amount written by the distribute loop.
Liquidity token amount supplied to the router call in list.
Recipient array driving the airdrop loop in list.
Per-recipient amount array driving the airdrop loop in list.
The boolean result is produced directly by the low-level protection call inside the checkBots modifier.
